criticalComponentsNote: Precipitation was critical through 1.1.0 and vetoed 15 of the 22 withheld destinations, in every month of the year. Rain makes a walk unpleasant; snow, heat, cold and darkness make it unsafe, and the veto belongs to that second group. Precipitation keeps its 20 percent weight, so a wet destination now scores low instead of disappearing.
bestMonthComponentNote: A month with a component at the very bottom of its scale cannot be a best month, whatever it adds up to. Separate from the recommendation floor of 20 and much stricter, because the two answer different questions: 20 is 'would we recommend walking here at all', 5 is 'is this the answer to when should I go'. Calibrated against tests/fixtures/known-hiking-seasons.json, where any value from 3 to 10 gives an identical result and 20 is visibly worse: at 20 the Dolomites lose July and August, whose rain component is 14 and 15 because of afternoon storms nobody stays home for, and Torres del Paine loses its season entirely. At 5 the Annapurna monsoon months, whose rain component is 0 with rain on every day of the month, are still excluded.
